title: Site-defined procedures: register a site's .tac files through defineSite and seed them on deploy
description: A site can only add a procedure by hand in Administration or via GraphQL; defineSite and site-backend have no procedure option and seeding is hardcoded to Papyrus's own procedures/newsroom. Let a site ship procedures (and their skills) in its repository, declared in papyrus.config.ts, and have deploy create or update the ProcedureDefinition/ProcedureVersion records.
